# profile_source

Profiles Bronze (an as-is copy of the source) to build the allowed-value lists and to record
the date ranges and the lines-per-order distribution. Read-only: it writes no tables.

Requires `01_bronze_ingest` to have run for the same `catalog` and `schema_prefix`.

%md
## Value profiling

### Categorical values
Every distinct value with its row count. NULL appears as its own row. `value_length` and the
bracketed value make leading or trailing whitespace visible.
